Source: FTW_favicon_attempt2.svg. "Try" swaps this page's real tab icon (it follows your OS light/dark setting). Regenerate with npm run favicon.

Plain spider: pick a dark mode

Light mode is the bare spider filling the square. Outline widths are per side at 16px; on a high-DPI screen the tab icon is drawn with twice the pixels, so ½px lands as one crisp device pixel. Thinner outlines leave more room, so the spider grows. Each cell: tab at real size, 32px, and true 16px blown up.

Other directions, true 16px blown up

Cropped

Plain, zoomed

Bigger face; the leg tips run off the edges. Dark mode adds the white outline. variants/plain-zoom.svg

String

Hanging on a string

String runs off the top edge and fills the empty space above. Dark mode adds the white outline. variants/string.svg

Swinging

Tilted 14°, like the logo spider mid-swing. Dark mode adds the white outline. variants/swing.svg

Web

String + corner webs

Teal cobwebs in the top corners. Likely too fine at 16px. Dark mode adds the white outline. variants/string-webs.svg

Sitting on a web

Teal web behind the spider, running off the edges. Dark mode adds the white outline. variants/on-web.svg

Box

Teal tile

Identical in light and dark. variants/tile-teal.svg

Teal tile + string

Spider hanging inside the tile. variants/tile-teal-string.svg

Teal circle

Round badge instead of a tile. variants/circle-teal.svg

Navy tile
